content: इध्म, इद्ध See under इन्ध. औदुम्बर इध्मः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 6. 3. 13</ls>.

इद्ध {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [इन्ध्-क्त] .²1 Kindled, lighted; रामस्य त्रिपुरान्तकृद्दिविषदां तेजोभिरिद्धं धनुः <ls>Mv. 1. 53</ls>; क्रोध˚ <ls>Ratn. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1. 2</ls>; ˚राग <ls>Ś. 7. 16</ls> whose glow or red colour has just broken out. .²2 Shining, glowing, blazing, bright; तन्वन्तमिद्धमभितो गुरुमंशुजालम् <ls>Ki. 2. 59</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 63</ls>; ˚बोधै <ls>Bk. 1. 5</ls> (पटुबुद्धिभिः) sharp. .²3 Clean, clear. .²4 Wonderful. .²5 Obeyed, unresisted (as order); ˚शासनः <ls>Ki. 1. 22</ls>. .{@-द्धम्@} .²1 Sunshine, heat. .²2 Refulgence, splendour. .²3 Wonder.
